user.title: Default settings
user.description: Default values for new stops: refreshing and 'refresh when in zone'. You can change them later under Configure → Settings, and per stop with the settings entities.

data_description.default_schedule: How often a stop refreshes itself, independent of the zone. 'Never' = only the button, the zone or your own automations.
data_description.default_radius: Radius around the stop (meters) within which a person counts as 'in the zone'.
data_description.default_refresh_on_approach: Refresh as soon as a followed person enters the zone. If a stop lies inside the Home Assistant home zone, this is off for that stop.
data_description.default_approach_only: After the first refresh on entry, only refresh when someone got at least 25 m closer.
data_description.default_zone_interval: How often to refresh while someone is in the zone. 'On entry' = once per visit.
data_description.default_zone_stop_after: After how many minutes a visit stops refreshing, even if you stay in the zone.

search.title: Search stops
search.description: Place the pin on the map and make the search circle larger or smaller by dragging its edge (50–5000 m, default 250 m). Below the map you see the matching coordinates and radius; they follow the pin. If you prefer an address or coordinates, enter them below (they take precedence over the pin; e.g. 52.1000, 5.1000). You then immediately get a list of the bus stops in that zone, each direction separately.

data_description.modes: Bus only by default. Tram, metro and ferry also have real-time data at OVapi.
data_description.place: Place name only (Voorbeeldstad): the map jumps to the centre of the town (2 km radius). Street + place (Voorbeeldlaan Voorbeeldstad) or an address: the pin is placed on that street or address. Press Enter/Submit, then move the pin if needed and submit again to search for stops.

select_stop.title: Select stops
select_stop.description:
Tick the bus stops you want to add. Each checkbox is one direction (one stop pole) with the current departures below it; buses with a different final destination in the same direction are merged. Every ticked stop becomes its own device.

stop_details.title: Set up stop

data.name: Name
data.destinations: Only destinations containing… (comma separated, empty = all)

data_description.destinations: E.g. Station, Noord: only shows departures whose destination contains one of these words.

manual.title: Enter TPC codes
manual.description: Enter one or more OVapi timing point codes, comma separated (e.g. 12345678). Next you choose a name and lines.

data.name: Name
data.destinations: Only destinations containing… (comma separated, empty = all)
data.marker_reset: Reset marker to the original position

data_description.destinations: E.g. Station, Noord: only shows departures whose destination contains one of these words.
data_description.marker: Drag the pin to move only the marker on the HA map. Distances and zones keep using the real stop position.
data_description.marker_reset: Tick and submit to reset the moved marker.

extra_options.title: Extra options
extra_options.description: Final settings for the chosen stops.

data.direction_in_name: Include the direction in the device name (→ …)
data.stale_hours: Hours before bus data counts as outdated
data.refresh_ndov: NDOV data {ndov_days} days old (file of {ndov_date}): download again

data_description.direction_in_name: On by default. Off: just the stop name (for example Voorbeeldstad, Markt); on: Voorbeeldstad, Markt → Station.
data_description.stale_hours: Default 12 hours. After that stops show 'Data vernieuwen' and a stop icon with a question mark. Change later under Configure → Settings.
data_description.refresh_ndov: Select this if the new or changed stop is not in the list. The configuration then starts over with the download.

menu_options.search: Search stops in a zone on the map

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed (PDOK or OVapi). See the log.
error.tpc_not_found: OVapi doesn't know this TPC code. Check the code; you can test it at v0.ovapi.nl/tpc/ followed by the code.
error.place_not_found: Place or address not found at PDOK.

abort.no_stops: No stops found within this radius.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Add stops via Configure.
abort.chb_failed: The stops could not be looked up (the NDOV Loket stop file is unavailable). Try again later or add a stop via 'Enter TPC codes'.

progress.download: The stop file from NDOV Loket is being downloaded (~13 MB). This only happens the first time and then every 14 days; progress is shown as a percentage in the circle.
progress.unpack: The stop file is being unpacked (~300 MB of XML, streamed) and converted to a compact index. This can take a few minutes on a Raspberry Pi; progress is shown as a percentage in the circle.
progress.load_stops: Looking up the bus stops in your zone and checking them live with OVapi.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Maximum number of departures in the attribute. Followed persons decide who triggers the 'Persons nearby' sensors and 'Refresh when in zone'.

data.map_logo: Use the logo on the HA map (off = plain bus icon)
data.stale_hours: Hours before bus data counts as outdated
data.line_sensors: Create a sensor per line (e.g. Line 74)

data_description.zone_cooldown: A new visit (with a new refresh on entry) only starts after the zone was empty this long. Several persons share one visit.
data_description.minute_updates: Off: entities are only updated on a refresh or when a bus leaves (fewer state writes). The shown minutes then do not count down.

data_description.default_zone_stop_after: After how many minutes a visit stops refreshing, even if you stay in the zone.
data_description.apply_existing: Also set these defaults on the stops that already exist (off by default).

data.api_max_errors: Errors before all automatic calls pause

data_description.max_errors: After this many consecutive errors a stop stops refreshing automatically (with a repair issue). The Refresh button always works and resumes the stop.
data_description.api_max_errors: After this many consecutive errors (or on HTTP 429) all automatic calls pause for a while; the last data stays visible.
data_description.api_spacing: Seconds between automatic OVapi calls, even with equal refresh frequencies. Manual refreshes never wait.

refresh.name: Refresh stop
refresh.description: Refreshes all stops, or only the stops (devices or entities) you pick as target.

ndov_outdated.title: NDOV stop file is outdated
ndov_outdated.description: The stop file is {days} days old (limit: {limit} days). New or changed stops may be missing. Open Configure → Search stops and tick *download again* to refresh it.

stop_paused.title: Stop {name} is paused
stop_paused.description: After {errors} consecutive errors this stop no longer refreshes automatically. Press the stop's *Refresh* button (or use the *Refresh stop* action) to try again; on success the stop resumes.

api_paused.title: OVapi is paused for a while
api_paused.description: After {errors} consecutive errors (or a 'too many requests' answer) automatic calls are paused temporarily. The last known departures stay visible. The integration retries by itself; refreshing manually always works.

stops_without_live_data.message: {count} stops without live data at OVapi are not shown.

list_truncated.message: ⚠️ **The list is truncated: the nearest {shown} of {total} directions are shown. Reduce the search radius to see the rest.**

explain_refresh_on_approach.message: On: as soon as a followed person enters the zone radius of this stop, the departures are refreshed right away (then at the refresh frequency in zone). If the stop is inside the Home Assistant home zone this is off by default. Followed persons are set under Configure.

explain_approach_only.message: On: refreshes in the zone (after the first one on entry) only happen when someone got at least {meters} m closer since the previous refresh.
